style: Style: vintage Saturday-morning monster cartoon still with a real horror edge, a heavy painted gouache background with deep inky blacks and one coloured light source (lantern orange or ghostly green), flat cel-painted characters with clean black outlines, anything monstrous drawn with grotesque detail and glowing eyes, high contrast, unsettling. Wide cinematic frame. No faces of the heroes shown, no text, no lettering except where stated.

pictures.hb_sporefall: Wickermoor's timber rooftops at night under what looks like snow, green-white flakes drifting through lamplight
pictures.hb_sporefall_2: A palm held up catching green-white flakes, beyond it a field of crops gone dark with rot and a villager's hunched back
pictures.hb_circle: Six gaunt antlered satyrs in a line at a tree line with drums and horns raised, two stag-bodied keepers lifting withered staves
pictures.hb_circle_2: A corpse in a dead commune bursting into a whirlwind of green spores under a crooked moon
pictures.hb_keepers_end: A world of trees, beasts and houses collapsing into rot
pictures.hb_keepers_end_2: Black nothing, then a flash of emerald and a pristine green wilderness
pictures.hb_wood_vision: A healthy ancient forest with a young woman dancing between the trees, laughing
pictures.hb_wood_vision_2: The same trees now black and shedding spores, the vision snapping
pictures.hb_wilds_vision: A rotting stag colossus seen from where someone kneels to eat it, only hands and flesh in view
pictures.hb_wilds_vision_2: A young woman lying dead beside the stag, then emerald light and her standing healthy in a green glade, smiling
pictures.hb_heart_vision: A gnarled oak with a hateful woman's face rotting into soil
pictures.hb_heart_vision_2: A sprout, a flash, and a radiant green elf-featured woman wreathed in emerald leaves
pictures.hb_halden_torso: A dead trapper's corpse shuddering against a carved beech tree in a mossy hollow
pictures.hb_halden_torso_2: Mould blooming over a torso as it is hauled up a trunk, its jaw hanging
pictures.hb_gwenna_rises: A churning green pool spilling ooze between leaning standing stones
pictures.hb_gwenna_rises_2: A mass of flesh and fungus standing in a humanlike shape, sheets of rot sliding off it
pictures.hb_pool_memory: A crystal pool in a ring of clean standing stones, a corpse held in someone's arms
pictures.hb_pool_memory_2: The body lowered into the water and the pool turning foul and erupting with spores
pictures.hb_beast_revealed: The gaunt top half of a satyr with long black hair hanging from a fungal cave wall
pictures.hb_beast_revealed_2: The wall tearing open as a colossal stag body of bone, blighted wood and fungus steps forward on cloven hooves
pictures.hb_gorthos_dies: A colossus of bone and fungus collapsing, its body running from green to brown to yellow sludge
pictures.hb_gorthos_dies_2: Motes drifting out of a cave mouth into the dark sky, toward another province
pictures.hb_backstory: Two young women walking hand in hand by the edge of a dark wood
pictures.hb_backstory_2: A satyr carrying a corpse into a hidden fungus-choked cave toward a dead stag the size of a barn
pictures.hb_missionaries: Patient Lady missionaries with sunflower lanterns setting off for the edge of a rotting forest
pictures.hb_missionaries_2: An Old Ways stag feast in a village square, antlers on poles, a goat watching with great calm
